The main takeaway from our work is that

, in the case of a nonlinear potential, the Schrodinger problem can be reduced to an eigenvalue problem for a differential operator involving a second-order differential equation and a first-order differential operator, which is not necessarily a derivative operator.

, in the case of the Schrodinger oscillator problem, the Rodrigues-type formula is not the only way to obtain solutions of a given spectral problem, but there are other ways, leading to more transparent results.
